'''Rogue 2'''<ref name="CCG-Rogue2" /> was an [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]]<ref name="CCG-Snowspeeder" /> modified [[T-47 airspeeder/Legends|T-47]] [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeder]]. Assigned to [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]],<ref name="CCG-Rogue2" /> the vehicle was stationed at the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance's]] [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on the ice [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="ESB" /> Rogue 2 was assigned to be [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by [[Zev Senesca/Legends|Zev Senesca]]<ref name="CCG-Rogue2" /> alongside [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] [[Kit Valent/Legends|Kit Valent]].<ref name="ITWSWT">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''</ref>

Rogue 2 was the first snowspeeder to be successfully adapted to operate in Hoth's cold environment,<ref name="CCG-Rogue2" /> and was successfully deployed to search for the lost [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. Senseca flew Rogue 2 in a search pattern and successfully located the pair.<ref name="ESB" /> During the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], Rogue 2 was part of the Alliance's snowspeeder counterattack<ref name="CCG-Rogue2" /> against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] force of [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]].<ref name="ESB" /> Rogue 2 was shot down and destroyed during the battle.<ref name="ESB" />
